en: The postcard features a black-and-white photograph of a large stone gate tower with an arched gateway (Marientor) and attached buildings, likely part of an old city wall. There are smaller structures and a shop visible on the left, with signs above the door. The setting appears historical, and the photo has a vintage feel. Text in red at the bottom names the location and publisher, with a date of 1905.
